McLaren Racing Is Now Available in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds With Free Car and Sonic Skin

McLaren Racing has arrived in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Grab Sonic's new racing outfit and car for free, with a special Festival kicking off November 19.

There’s a McLaren on the starting grid in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds today!

SEGA’s latest free update is out now, bringing the McLaren Racing Car and a matching Sonic (McLaren Racing) outfit to the game.

We first got a look at this collaboration during October’s Year Two showcase, and now players can finally take the Speed-type McLaren Racing Car out onto the track. It’s based on the team’s real-world racing machine, complete with that familiar Papaya and Anthracite livery.

Both the car and Sonic’s new racing suit are completely free. You’ll just need an internet connection to claim them.

There’s a launch trailer to go with the update, too.

And, as we’ve come to expect from CrossWorlds updates, there’s another Festival just around the corner.

The McLaren Racing Festival kicks off November 19 at 7:00 PM ET and runs until November 29 at 6:59 PM ET, giving players another chance to rack up Festival Points and collect some new rewards.

This time around, the rewards include the McLaren Racing Driver title, an Overtake Button gadget, a decal featuring Sonic, Tails and Knuckles in McLaren Racing gear, and a horn sporting the team’s branding.

The Blue Crown is also up for grabs, going to the player with the most Rule Points on the winning team.

One thing worth remembering before you start collecting: deleting your save data will also wipe your Festival rewards, and you won’t be able to earn them again. SEGA says gadgets and other rewards may still return through future updates.

It’s a busy week for Sonic and McLaren, too. Just ahead of the update, SEGA revealed Sonic the Hedgehog x McLaren Racing: Beyond Fast, a three-part animated special that takes the partnership beyond the racetrack.

Stay tuned to Sonic City for more Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds News and Updates!
